claims: Rick Pitino is the head men's basketball coach at St. John's University.
Rick Pitino was named the 22nd coach in St. John's University men's basketball program history on March 20, 2023.
Rick Pitino signed a six-year contract at St. John's.
Rick Pitino achieved his 900th career victory in February 2026.
Rick Pitino led St. John's to a top-five seed in the 2025-2026 season.
Rick Pitino led St. John's to an NCAA Tournament Round of 32 appearance in the 2025-2026 season.
Rick Pitino is a two-time NCAA National Champion with Kentucky and Louisville.
Rick Pitino is a Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame inductee (2013).
Rick Pitino has previously coached at Kentucky.
Rick Pitino has previously coached at Louisville.
Rick Pitino has previously coached at Iona.
